device_label: 500 um O-band SOH MZM, SOXD-224, multi-level doping
il_onchip_includes: two 2x2 MMI couplers (0.24 dB), two strip-to-slot and two slot-to-strip converters (1.02 dB), about 3.5 mm of 420 nm strip access waveguide (1.12 dB), 0.5 mm slot-waveguide phase shifters (2.22 dB, remainder)
il_onchip_excludes: grating couplers (4.6 dB per grating coupler, p.4)
cladding: SOXD-224 organic electro-optic material (n 1.85) in the slot, micro-dispensed onto the finished chip; 5 um top-oxide cladding elsewhere
epitaxy_or_stack: Silicon slot waveguide on SOI, 3 um BOX, 5 um TOX: nominal rails 220 nm high and 220 nm wide, slot 160 nm, slab 90 nm; TEM of a raw device (no OEO): rail height 205 nm, rail width 208 nm and slot 160 nm at half rail height, slab 75 nm, sidewall inclined 10 deg from the wafer normal, slot over-etched 215 nm into the BOX; multi-level doping n_D / n_D+ / n_D++ with weakly doped width w_weak about 720 nm; Al vias and GSG line; arm length imbalance about 40 um; field-interaction factor 0.17 (simulated)
modulation_format: PAM4 192 GBd (384 Gbit/s) at 0.95 Vpp: BER 2.7e-2 (below 20% SD-FEC), AIR 332.4, NDR 310.9 Gbit/s (best NDR under sub-1 Vpp drive); PAM4 176 GBd (352 Gbit/s) at 0.94 Vpp: BER 1.4e-2, and highest NDR 323.5 Gbit/s (AIR 340.5) at 1.17 Vpp; PAM4 144 GBd at 0.9 Vpp: BER 7.2e-3; PAM4 112 GBd at 0.95 Vpp: BER 1e-3; single carrier IMDD, wavelength 1326 nm
driver: Keysight M8199B AWG (80 GHz 6 dB bandwidth), direct drive without RF amplifier; 20 cm cable and 110 GHz probe; 50 ohm termination probe; zero-forcing pre-distortion; receiver Finisar BPDV4120R after O-band SOA; Keysight UXR1104B oscilloscope
notes: Single device. Vpi 0.92 V from a 1 kHz triangular sweep at 1310 nm (UpiL 0.46 V mm reported, stored as 0.046 V cm). Mixed operating points in the max_* columns: max_baud 192 GBd, max_line_rate 384 Gbit/s and drive 0.95 Vpp belong to the 192 GBd PAM4 point (NDR 310.9 Gbit/s, the best under sub-1 Vpp drive), while max_net_rate 323.5 Gbit/s (AIR 340.5) is the highest NDR of the paper and belongs to the 176 GBd PAM4 point at 1.17 Vpp. Drive voltage was measured with the oscilloscope at the RF cable that feeds the probe (probe excluded), so the voltage at the chip is slightly lower. Wavelengths: Vpi at 1310 nm; ER above 20 dB around 1330 nm (Fig. 1b, fringes of a 40 um imbalanced MZM); data experiment at 1326 nm (grating-coupler peak, 9.5 dBm laser, -8.3 dBm after the DUT; laser power not on-chip power). On-chip IL 4.6 dB from the same fringe spectrum (text: around/approximately 4.6 dB; Table I sum 4.60); the unit loss 4.44 dB/mm of the slot waveguide is the remainder after subtracting MMI, converter and strip-waveguide losses (derived, 44.4 dB/cm); FCA-only simulation gives 1.1 dB/mm. Bandwidth: Fig. B1(b) smoothed measured EO response, 0 dB at low frequency (frequency not stated); caption 3 dB 20 GHz and 6 dB 40 GHz (text: approximately 40 GHz); RC corner 54 GHz; roll-off about 12.5 dB at 96 GHz (Nyquist of 192 GBd); RF-loss-limited 3 dB bandwidth 95 GHz and impedance-mismatch dip near 33 GHz from the model, not entered. RF loss: |S21,EE| about 7 dB at 100 GHz for the 0.5 mm line (measured, Fig. B1a) converted to 140 dB/cm. Z0 about 37 ohm quoted next to the verified model, not stated as measured (entered with basis simulated). r33 210 pm/V is the authors estimate from Eq. (1) with simulated Gamma 0.17 and n 1.85. Geometry: rail width 208 nm and slab 75 nm are TEM values of a raw device from the run, nominal 220 nm and 90 nm; 10 deg sidewall angle is from the wafer normal (80 deg from the film plane, derived). Wafer run had a sheet resistivity of the weakly doped slab 3x above target and a high-roughness run (strip 0.32 dB/mm). Not reported: n_RF, ng, energy per bit, on-chip optical power, electrode gap/width/thickness, temperature, foundry name.

device_label: 1 mm SOH MZM at 11 K, Perkinamine Series 5G OEO, three-level doping
cladding: Organic electro-optic material based on Perkinamine Series 5G (Lightwave Logic Inc.), poled
epitaxy_or_stack: Silicon slot waveguide; GSG RF line connected through metal vias to doped Si slabs; three-level doping N / N+ / N++ (N+ and N++ degenerate, no carrier freeze-out), weakly doped N rails form the slot; slot filled with the organic EO material; optional 2 x 100 ohm terminations (Fig. 1b)
modulation_format: PAM4 70 GBd (140 Gbit/s) at 11 K, 1.4 Vpp, 2 dBm on chip: BER 2.3e-2 (below 20% SD-FEC); OOK terminated: 60 Gb/s below HD-FEC at 0.92 Vpp (1 dBm, 71 fJ/bit), 90 Gb/s below HD-FEC at 1.34 Vpp (2 dBm, 100 fJ/bit), 100 Gb/s below SD-FEC at 1.2 Vpp (72 fJ/bit); OOK unterminated 60 Gb/s below HD-FEC at 0.92 Vpp (38 fJ/bit), 10 Gb/s error-free at 0.23 Vpp (2 fJ/bit); OOK drive voltages are author on-chip estimates; the reference plane of the 1.4 Vpp PAM4 value is not stated
driver: AWG with 11 dB RF amplifier at room temperature, coaxial cable to cryogenic RF probes; 50 ohm termination optional; Keysight UXR1004A real-time oscilloscope
notes: Headline: Upi 0.92 V at 11 K (abstract; body prints 0.9 V measured at RT and at 11 K on a 1 mm device, procedure per their ref. 9: frequency, wavelength and arm convention not stated; drive push_pull and vpi_convention mzm_push_pull are derived from the single GSG feed of two slot arms and the same-group procedure, the authors do not state push-pull). wavelength 1532 nm is the data-link laser (EDFA to 10.5 dBm after the MZM); the Vpi wavelength is not stated. Length 1 mm is stated for the Vpi device; the length of the transmission device is not stated. Cryostat base temperature 11 K (higher than the usual 4 K because of excess thermal load of the probing setup); device temperature is not separately stated. Mixed operating points in this row: max_baud 100 GBd is the OOK 100 Gb/s point (derived), drive 1.4 Vpp and 2 dBm are the PAM4 70 GBd eye, energy 72 fJ/bit is the OOK 100 Gb/s point at 1.2 Vpp; energy figures are the paper electrical energy dissipation Wbit from on-chip drive voltage (driver amplifier not stated as included). The OOK on-chip drive voltages are author estimates (cable loss strongly frequency dependent, Fig. 1c); the 1.4 Vpp PAM4 value is the stated eye setting with reference plane not stated; BER at RT is better than at 11 K (attributed to residual carrier freeze-out in the N region and vibration-induced coupling changes). Not reported: insertion loss, bandwidth, extinction ratio, geometry, electrode metal.

device_label: 4.0 mm CL-TWE twin-IQ InP PIC, n-i-p-n, flip-chip terminated
il_onchip_includes: per polarization, estimated at the bias for Vpi below 1.5 V, includes about 1 dB excess loss from band-edge absorption
il_onchip_excludes: fiber coupling (implied by "on chip"); otherwise not defined in the paper
epitaxy_or_stack: n-i-p-n heterostructure: thick n-doped layer, undoped core, thin p-doped layer under the undoped layer (electron blocker), n-doped layer; ridge waveguide (inverted-trapezoidal by wet etching of the [011] stripe); I/O passive region: deep-ridge waveguide with semi-insulating over-cladding replacing the n-doped layer; vertical-tapered spot-size converter; layer thicknesses and doping not stated
notes: Twin-IQ PIC with differential GSSG line and flip-chip terminators; 4.0 mm long CL-TWE (periodic length shortened from 200 to 150 um; measured EE responses roll off over 100 GHz, Fig. 3); chip 3.3 x 8.3 mm2. Vpi 1.5 V (title/abstract; Sec. III-A: DC bias adjusted for Vpi of less than 1.5 V, push-pull/differential drive, Fig. 6, 1550 nm); applied bias at 1.5 V Vpi about 10 V (reverse, entered as -10) in the PIC itself, 3.6 to 9.8 V from 1527 to 1565 nm with a DC-coupled driver (Fig. 7). Vpi frequency not stated (static). Drive series_push_pull and vpi_convention mzm_series_push_pull are derived: Fig. 2(b) shows both ridges on one common n-layer, Fig. 7(a) draws the two arms as diodes in series between the differential driver outputs with the modulator bias on the common node, and the Fig. 6 caption reads "push-pull drive"; the paper wording is "differential GSSG line" / "differential drive", not "series" (same label as ogiso2016/ogiso2024; the Vpi value is the voltage between the two signal lines either way). EO: Fig. 10 small-signal response with flip-chip terminations, I and Q channels, 0 dB at low frequency (frequency not stated), commercial calibrated OE module; 3 dB approximately 80 GHz, 6 dB approximately 100 GHz, trace extends to about 105 GHz (read from figure, not entered); S11 below -10 dB. IL 8.5 dB is the paper estimate of the overall on-chip loss per polarization at that bias (excess band-edge absorption approximately 1 dB); the fiber-to-fiber loss 9.0 dB belongs to the single-IQ sub-assembly row; the two figures are not directly comparable (different PICs: twin-IQ per-polarization path vs single-IQ; scopes not defined; whether the twin-IQ figure includes the X/Y split is not stated). Propagation loss estimated below 1.5 dB/cm for both the modulation and the passive waveguide. Static ER better than 25 dB for all sub-MZMs. eo_effect qcse entered as the InP default, primary mechanism not designated: Fig. 1 names FK/QCSE and Pockels contributions adding (+Delta n) for the n-i-p-n [011] stripe (synergistic effect, ref. 10). Not reported: RF loss, Z0, n_RF, ng, optical power, temperature, epitaxial thicknesses, fabrication site.

device_label: Single-IQ InP PIC with InP DHBT driver IC sub-assembly (bond wires), 128 GBd QPSK
modulation_format: back-to-back single polarization: QPSK 128 GBd BER 3.38e-5 (below 20% SD-FEC; oscilloscope 63 GHz insufficient); QPSK 120 GBd error-free at OSNR 29.5 dB; 16QAM 112 GBd BER 6.68e-3 at OSNR 29.5 dB; 600 mVppd differential driver input, 45 C
driver: InP DHBT two-channel differential linear driver IC (in-house 0.25 um InP DHBT, ft 460 GHz, fmax 480 GHz; variable-gain amplifier plus cascode output buffer, 25 x 2 ohm differential terminations, 1.5 Vppd linear swing, bandwidth over 67 GHz with gain peaking over 6 dB at 60 GHz), bond-wired to the PIC; PAM4 mux SHF 616A; quad-channel BPG up to 64 Gb/s
notes: Drive series_push_pull derived as for the twin-IQ PIC (the paper says "differential"). Sub-assembly of a single-IQ modulator PIC (electrical design and characteristics almost the same as the twin-IQ PIC, flip-chip terminators replaced by bond-wire connection to the driver) co-assembled with the InP driver IC; length, Vpi and ER of this PIC are not stated. EO bandwidth (Fig. 12b) is the driver-plus-modulator response, 3 dB exceeded over the 67 GHz measured range with gain peaking of about 5 dB near 55 to 60 GHz; instrument not stated, 0 dB at low frequency. Fiber-to-fiber insertion loss of the PIC 9.0 dB (setup sentence, p.5). Setup: ECL 1550 nm, +2 dBm, amplified to +16 dBm by an EDFA and coupled into the PIC (fiber power, not on-chip), 600 mVppd differential driver input and 45 C modulator temperature (stated as operating temperature of the modulator); voltage at the modulator not stated, so drive_vpp_v empty. Receiver single-polarization offline coherent, DSO 160 GSa/s and 63 GHz. Line rates not stated (QPSK 128 GBd and 16QAM 112 GBd per polarization). The twin-IQ and sub-assembly PICs are different chips; physical_device_id empty. Not reported: Vpi, length, ER, RF loss, energy per bit.
